reasoning: The icon issolely the lowercase letter 'i', which is an unenclosed typographic glyph and generic UI chrome for 'info'. Because almost every task with 'info' in the title is actually about a specific subject (flights, bank details, medical records), a bare letter 'i' is too abstract and visually indistinct from an inverted exclamation mark to serve as a task subject icon.
